subject: MAP milestones, pilot credit extension and conversion terms
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & pilot: proposed milestones and pilot credits

Hi Olivia —

Great speaking yesterday. As discussed, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out a 30-day pilot, key integration milestones, and the commercial conversion options we can offer if the pilot hits the agreed checkpoints. High-level proposal: 

- Pilot window: 30 days (start on integration complete)
- Pilot credits: 100k token-equivalent trial credits applied to the account
- Integration milestone (by day 10): ingestion pipeline + sample inference at SLA X
- Quality milestone (by day 25): baseline score >= 0.78 on your evaluation set
- Conversion options: tiered discounts on committed monthly spend (details in attached MAP)

Can you confirm the MAP items below, and whether you want us to extend the pilot duration or add any specific ADT/integration checkpoints? If this looks right I can loop in our solutions team and legal to prep a quick PO + DocuSign package.

Attachment: Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

From: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@nimbushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jake.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot: proposed milestones and pilot credits

Ben —

Thanks for the draft. A few items from our side:

1) Timeline: The integration team needs a bit more runway; can we extend the pilot to 45 days instead of 30?
2) Credits: 100k is a good start, but if we reach the integration milestone AND the quality milestone we would need an extra top-up to continue validation on a second dataset (another ~50k). Can that be conditional?
3) Conversion pricing: we need clearer ramp pricing and an initial term that acknowledges our expected growth. Can you share a pricing example tied to a 6-month commit?
4) Procurement: Procurement wants to see a skeleton PO and typical procurement lead time — Jake is looped here for timeline.

If you can get us a revised MAP with the 45-day pilot + conditional additional credits tied to milestone completion, and an indicative conversion price table for a 6-month commit, we can try to fast-track procurement.

Appreciate it —
Olivia
VP, Product & Data
Nimbus Health
olivia.tran@nimbushealth.com | +1 617-555-2234

Subject: Re: MAP & pilot: proposed milestones and pilot credits

Olivia —

Thanks — looping in our solutions engineer (Dev) and my manager (Lauren) to confirm feasibility and approval. Quick response/compromise from our side: 

- Pilot window: extend to 45 days (agreed)
- Pilot credits: 100k initial credits + conditional top-up of 50k credits if both the integration milestone (day 10) and quality milestone (day 25) are met and validated by our SRE/SE team
- Conversion pricing (example for 6-month minimum commit):
    * Month 1-3: 15% off list on committed spend
    * Month 4-6: 7% off list on committed spend
    * Minimum: 6-month monetary commit (we can include a ramp figure; suggest starting commit at $25k/mo)
- Condition: the conditional top-up credits are applied only after a signed PO and an acceptance verification call (we need to confirm test artifacts).

I'll have Dev confirm the test acceptance criteria and Lauren sign off on the commercials. Once internal approval is formalized I'll send a revised MAP and PO skeleton (DocuSign link) for Nimbus procurement.

Action items: Dev to propose precise acceptance checks. Lauren to confirm discount cadence. I will prepare a DocuSign-ready MAP.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & pilot: proposed milestones and pilot credits

Ben / Lauren —

Technically we can validate the integration and quality milestones as requested. Suggested acceptance checklist:

- Integration milestone (expected by day 10):
  * Ingestion pipeline accepts sample payloads at 50 TPS for sustained 10m window
  * KV cache behavior validated with 2M tokens of context
  * Endpoint latency at p95 <= 220ms for 512-token requests

- Quality milestone (expected by day 25):
  * Evaluation harness run on Nimbus dataset v1 (test set) with baseline metrics >= 0.78 F1-equivalent score as defined in MAP
  * Regression tests for hallucination rates under 3% on the evaluation set

Notes: If both milestones pass we can automate the 50k credit top-up via account tagging; we will require an acceptance call and final sign-off by SRE. Also, we should explicitly call out that credits can only be used on the pilot environment and do not auto-convert to paid credits.

I can prepare the acceptance checklist as a short addendum to the MAP.

—Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Okay to extend to 45 days and to make the 50k top-up contingent on milestone completion, but two controls from legal/finance: 

1) Top-up is contingent on milestone completion AND a signed PO (we don't apply promotional credits against an open commercial negotiation).
2) Limit total promotional credits to 150k across the pilot (100k initial + 50k top-up).

Commercial tweak approved:
- Month 1-3: 15% off list on committed spend (confirm starting commit $25k/mo)
- Month 4-6: 7% off list on committed spend
- 6-month minimum monetary commit required to qualify for the discount ladder

Ben: please confirm you will include the PO skeleton and DocuSign link in the next send. Dev: add the acceptance checklist as an appendix to the MAP.

Lauren

Subject: Final MAP + pilot extension & conversion terms (next steps)

Olivia / Jacob —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals together. Summary of the agreed path and next steps: 

Agreed pilot terms:
- Pilot window: 45 days starting from production-like integration sign-off
- Pilot credits: 100k initial credits applied at pilot start
- Conditional top-up: 50k credits applied after successful completion of integration checklist (day 10) AND quality evaluation (day 25) AND receipt of signed PO
- Total promotional credits cap: 150k

Conversion pricing (6-month minimum commit example):
- Month 1-3: 15% off list on committed monthly spend (suggested starting commit $25k/month)
- Month 4-6: 7% off list on committed monthly spend
- Minimum: 6-month monetary commitment required to qualify for the discount ladder

Acceptance criteria: Dev will attach an appendix with the technical checklist (ingestion, latency p95, evaluation harness results). Credits will be applied to the pilot environment only and are non-transferable.

Procurement/PO: Please see attached PO skeleton (NIMB-PO-skeleton.docx). If Nimbus can return a signed PO by Nov 20 we will schedule the acceptance call and kick off the pilot immediately after integration validation. DocuSign link (skeleton) is here: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/NIMB-2026

Attachments: Nimbus-MAP-v1.pdf, NIMB-PO-skeleton.docx

Next steps: 
1) Jacob: confirm procurement timing and send PO draft by Nov 17 if possible
2) Dev: post the acceptance appendix to the MAP and share the list of test artifacts (by Nov 11)
3) Ben: send finalized MAP + DocuSign envelope once above items received

If this all looks correct I'll send the DocuSign envelope and lock the dates.

Thanks,
